evidence: Begin at the Okahu Road end; its 2 hr (7 km) from there to Skips Hut (Whangatawhia).
From Skips Hut the track climbs up over a saddle before tracking down to Rogers Hut.
From Rogers it's an easy walk to the next overnight destination: Moerangi Hut.
The final day of walking includes a big climb over the Moerangi Saddle.
Walk among the giant trees until you end at the River Rd carpark.

doubts: Moerangi Hut: the page calls it a detour about 500 m up from the main track ('a slight detour', and the mountain bike section says 'the short detour to Moerangi Hut'), but the Day 2 heading makes it the overnight destination of the walk, so it is treated as on the way and as a hut on the route, with the detour noted here. Start and end: the page names the Okahu Road end and the River Rd carpark, but no road end feature in the packet matches either, so both refs are null. The Moerangi Saddle and the saddle between Skips Hut and Rogers Hut are unnamed on the map, so the second has no ref. The mountain bike section describes the same track from Okahu Valley Rd to River Road car park, so it is not recorded as a separate way. The DOC time '3 days' is the whole way's time; the day times (3 hr 30 min, 3 hr, 4 hr 30 min) are not summed.
